name: gibs-polar
title: NASA GIBS polar WMTS tile matrices (EPSG:3031, EPSG:3413)
description: One quadtree per pole: 512 px tiles from the top-left corner (-4194304, 4194304), cell 8192 m / 2^z. The named matrix sets (1km, 500m, 250m, 31.25m) are depth limits on this ladder.

provenance.derived_from: TileMatrixSet definitions in the capabilities documents, tools/fixtures-wmts.py
notes: The matrix set names are nominal: '250m' has 256 m cells at its deepest level, '31.25m' has 32 m (the cells are 8192 / 2^z exactly). A spec should carry the numbers, not the names.
EPSG:3031 matrices go to z = 5 (256 m), EPSG:3413 to z = 8 (32 m); recorded as zmax in the instance table, not yet enforced by the schema.
The domain is the full matrix (+-4194304 m, 2^(z+1) tiles a side); which tiles hold imagery depends on the layer.
rema-ovr's explorer uses this grid as its display tile matrix in EPSG:3031 (256 px tiles there, the same lattice).
